Anna (Sales): Hey team — customer doing a proof-of-concept needs EU-only data residency + edge peering for latency. Main asks: list of subprocessors in eu regions, routing precedence (tenant pin vs geo-failover), and delta on pricing for EU-only pin + BYOK. Can someone confirm what we can commit for a POC? :wave:
Louis (Solutions): I can take the POC scope. Quick clarifying q: do they want tenant pinned to a specific EU region (e.g. eu-west-1) or just stay inside EU footprint and allow failover across EU regions?
Anna (Sales): They want strict residency during the POC — no cross-border egress even for failover. So preferred: tenant pin to eu-west-1 for the POC window.
Sam (Infra): Short answer: we can pin a tenant to a specific region in Private and Dedicated modes. Hosted can do tenancy affinity but not strict hard pin without Dedicated/Private. For the POC we can offer a temporary Dedicated reservation or Private VPC option.
Louis (Solutions): OK. What about subprocessors — they asked for an EU-only subprocessor chain. Which of our infra partners are EU-only?
Sam (Infra): Current EU subprocessors: AWS eu-west-1(owner), FastNet CDN (EU POPs), KeyStore Inc (EU KMS region), and ManagedLogging EU (logs stored in eu-central-1). I can attach the attestation doc, but Legal should confirm whether that list meets their compliance needs.
Elaine (Legal): Please attach the Subprocessor Attestation and the SOC2/ISO scopes. Also need to know if customer BYOK implies key material never leaves customer's HSM. For BYOK, we require an HSM/KMS integration with region-bound keys; confirm which KMS providers we support in eu-west-1.
Sam (Infra): Supported KMS in eu-west-1: AWS KMS (customer key via grant), KeyStore Inc (partner HSM), and CloudHSM via Private deployment. BYOK can be done — in Dedicated we can mount a customer-managed key and ensure decrypt only in-region.
Maya (Ops): For the POC, ops asks for certs and CNAMEs for peering. We'll need an RFC to create a tenant-specific CNAME, plus the peering ASN and IP ranges. I can draft the runbook if Sam confirms IP ranges and TLS termination point.
Sam (Infra): Peering details: ASN 64512, prefix set: 3x /24s per tenant (will provide exact ranges), TLS terminates on customer side if Private VPC; for Dedicated we terminate at load balancer in eu-west-1.
Louis (Solutions): Pricing question from buyer: what is the delta for EU-only pinning + BYOK for a 3-month POC (estimate 10M tokens/month)? Need a ballpark to include in proposal.
Anna (Sales): They asked for a single number to share with procurement. Include: Dedicated reservation + premium for region pin + BYOK setup fee.
Maya (Ops): Ballpark: Dedicated 4x GPU pool reservation ~ $22k/month, region pin premium +15% on base throughput, BYOK integration one-time $8k (engineering + ops), and networking (peering/CNAME) ~ $1.5k one-time. I can calc a rough monthly with three-month commit.
Elaine (Legal): Add note: procurement will need subprocessor contract addendum and Data Processing Addendum with EU SCCs if cross-border is possible. Since they require strict EU-only during POC, confirm we put a clause: no cross-border egress for the POC window, except written emergency fallback.
Anna (Sales): Good — can you get a short blurb I can paste into the SOW and the commercial quote line items?
Louis (Solutions): I'll draft the technical SOW for the POC (pinning, routing policy, peering steps, test plan with latency targets) and attach the infra checklist. Also adding curl snippet for their engineers to smoke test endpoint: ```curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://inference.eu-west-1.redwood.example/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'```
Sam (Infra): I'll upload the subprocessor attestation and the exact IP prefixes + cert requirements by EOD.
Maya (Ops): I'll scope the runbook and estimate 8 hours of ops effort for the handoff; will include the CNAME template and peering RFC.
Anna (Sales): Perfect. @Elaine any blockers from legal before we send the draft SOW and provisional quote?
Elaine (Legal): No blockers if we include the subprocessor list + DPA + the emergency-fallback wording. I'll prepare a one-paragraph compliance blurb to attach.
Anna (Sales): Thanks all — I'll assemble the SOW + commercial and send to the buyer tomorrow morning. :raised_hands:
